description: Key model of the nx firmware (docs/nx/key-model.md). Hold times are the gesture thresholds plus a margin.

notes.open_list: G1/G2 on the dashboard: the shown generator or one without a program opens its program list (as the original), another one takes the focus first; in the list G1/G2 only choose the target, so the second press is harmless
notes.focus: G1/G2: dashboard of that generator (a push)
notes.nav_up: UP in a list: move up (on the dashboard UP opens quick settings)
notes.nav_down: DOWN in a list: move down (on the dashboard DOWN opens the menu)
notes.confirm: START in the program list: load the selected slot into the target, back to its dashboard
notes.play_pause: START on the focused generator's dashboard (focus it first)
notes.stop: STOP released within 0.5 s on the focused generator's dashboard (focus it first)
notes.loop: LOOP released within 0.5 s: repeat on/off while running, play looped otherwise (held: the program detail)
notes.stop_all: STOP held 1 s, then released, stops both generators (held 1.2 s here)
notes.power_hold: POWER held 0.8 s powers off (held 1.0 s here)
notes.screen_toggle: POWER released within 0.5 s: screen off / on
notes.wake: any key wakes a dark screen and does nothing else (UP here)
notes.lock: G1+G2 held 1.5 s lock the keys (1.7 s here)
notes.locked_try: START while locked: the lock card, nothing else
notes.unlock: START+STOP held 1.5 s unlock the keys (1.7 s here)
